intro_en: You will learn to talk about grades, exams and retakes, and to say what happens if you don't pass. You will use Mongolian -хгүй бол and English 'unless' for negative conditions.
intro_mn: Та оноо, дүн, шалгалт, дахин өгөх тухай ярьж, тэнцэхгүй бол юу болохыг хэлж сурна. Сөрөг нөхцөлийг монгол хэлэнд -хгүй бол, англи хэлэнд 'unless'-ээр илэрхийлнэ.

vocab.example_mn: Миний оноо хангалттай өндөр биш байна.

vocab.example_en: The exam results will come out tomorrow.
I need to retake my exam.
The teacher gave an assessment of my work.
The teacher gave us our grades.

vocab.example_mn: Тэр өвдсөн учраас хичээлээс чөлөө авсан.
vocab.example_en: He took leave from classes because he got sick.

vocab.example_mn: Сайн дүнтэй бол тэтгэлэг авч болно.
vocab.example_en: With good grades you can get a scholarship.

sentences.mn: Хэрэв тэнцэхгүй бол би дахин өгнө.
sentences.en: If I don't pass, I will retake it.
alt_en: If I fail, I'll take it again.
sentences.mn_latin: Kherev tentsekhgüi bol bi dakhin ögnö.

sentences.en: If you don't study, you won't pass the exam.
alt_en: Unless you study, you won't pass the exam.

sentences.en: When will the exam results come out?
alt_en: When are the exam results coming out?

sentences.mn: Би хангалттай оноо авахгүй бол тэтгэлгээ алдана.
sentences.en: If I don't get enough points, I'll lose my scholarship.
alt_en: Unless I get enough points, I'll lose my scholarship.
sentences.mn_latin: Bi khangalttai onoo avakhgüi bol tetgelgee aldana.

sentences.mn: Тэр шалгалтад унасан болохоор дахин өгөх ёстой.
sentences.en: He failed the exam, so he has to retake it.
alt_en: Because he failed the exam, he must retake it.
sentences.mn_latin: Ter shalgaltad unasan bolokhoor dakhin ögökh yostoi.

sentences.mn: Багш зөвшөөрөхгүй бол бид шалгалтыг хойшлуулж чадахгүй.
sentences.en: If the teacher doesn't agree, we can't postpone the exam.
alt_en: Unless the teacher agrees, we can't postpone the exam.
sentences.mn_latin: Bagsh zövshöörökhgüi bol bid shalgaltyg khoishluulj chadakhgüi.

sentences.mn: Миний дүн муу байсан ч би бууж өгөөгүй.
sentences.en: My grade was bad, but I didn't give up.
alt_en: Even though my grade was bad, I didn't give up.
sentences.mn_latin: Minii dün muu baisan ch bi buuj ögöögüi.

sentences.mn: Оноо чинь хүрэхгүй бол дахин өгөх шаардлагатай.
sentences.en: If your score isn't enough, you need to retake it.
alt_mn: Оноо хүрэхгүй бол дахин өгөх хэрэгтэй.
alt_en: Unless your score is enough, you need to retake it.
sentences.mn_latin: Onoo chini khürekhgüi bol dakhin ögökh shaardlagatai.

sentences.mn: Чи цагтаа ирэхгүй бол би чамайг хүлээхгүй.
sentences.en: If you don't come on time, I won't wait for you.
alt_en: Unless you come on time, I won't wait for you.
sentences.mn_latin: Chi tsagtaa irekhgüi bol bi chamaig khüleekhgüi.

sentences.mn: Бүх хичээлдээ тэнцвэл би зун амарна.
sentences.en: If I pass all my classes, I'll rest in the summer.
alt_en: If I pass all my courses, I'll relax this summer.
sentences.mn_latin: Bükh khicheeldee tentsvel bi zun amarna.

sentences.mn: Дахин өгөхгүй бол чи энэ хичээлийг дуусгаж чадахгүй.
sentences.en: Unless you retake it, you can't finish this course.
alt_en: If you don't retake it, you can't complete this course.
sentences.mn_latin: Dakhin ögökhgüi bol chi ene khicheeliig duusgaj chadakhgüi.

sentences.mn: Бэлдэхгүй бол унах вий гэж айж байна.
sentences.en: I'm afraid I'll fail if I don't prepare.
alt_en: I'm worried I'll fail unless I prepare.
sentences.mn_latin: Beldekhgüi bol unakh vii gej aij baina.

grammar.explain_en: To say 'if not' in Mongolian, add -хгүй бол to the verb stem: тэнцэхгүй бол (if I/you don't pass), хичээллэхгүй бол (if you don't study). The ending doesn't change for person. English 'unless' means 'if ... not', and the verb after it is positive: 'Unless you study, you won't pass' = 'If you don't study, you won't pass.' You can't say 'Unless you don't study.' Also, for the future, use the present tense after 'unless', not 'will': 'Unless he comes, we will start' (not 'Unless he will come'). The main clause usually has 'will' or 'can'.
grammar.explain_mn: Монгол хэлэнд 'хэрэв ... биш бол' гэсэн утгыг үйл үгийн үндэс дээр -хгүй бол залгаж илэрхийлнэ: тэнцэхгүй бол, хичээллэхгүй бол. Энэ нөхцөл нь бие хүнээр хувирдаггүй. Англи хэлэнд 'unless' нь 'if ... not' буюу '-хгүй бол' гэсэн утгатай. Харин 'unless'-ийн дараах үйл үг эерэг хэлбэртэй байдаг: 'Unless you study, you won't pass' = 'If you don't study, you won't pass.' 'Unless you don't study' гэж хэлж болохгүй. Мөн 'unless'-ийн дараа ирээдүй цагийг 'will'-ээр бус одоо цагаар хэлнэ: 'Unless he comes, we will start' ('Unless he will come' гэж болохгүй). Үндсэн өгүүлбэр нь ихэвчлэн 'will' эсвэл 'can' агуулна.

dialogue.speaker: Saruul
dialogue.mn: Бат аа, шалгалтын дүн гарсан уу?
dialogue.en: Bat, have the exam results come out?
dialogue.mn_latin: Bat aa, shalgaltyn dün garsan uu?

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.mn: Гарсан. Би дөнгөж тэнцсэн, оноо маань бага байна.
dialogue.en: Yes. I barely passed, and my score is low.
dialogue.mn_latin: Garsan. Bi döngöj tentssen, onoo maani baga baina.

dialogue.speaker: Saruul
dialogue.mn: Би айж байна. Хэрэв унавал яах вэ?
dialogue.en: I'm nervous. What if I fail?
dialogue.mn_latin: Bi aij baina. Kherev unaval yaakh ve?

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.mn: Унавал дараа сард дахин өгч болно.
dialogue.en: If you fail, you can retake it next month.
dialogue.mn_latin: Unaval daraa sard dakhin ögch bolno.

dialogue.speaker: Saruul
dialogue.en: But I might lose my scholarship.

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.mn: Сайн бэлдэхгүй бол тийм эрсдэл бий.
dialogue.en: Unless you prepare well, there is that risk.
dialogue.mn_latin: Sain beldekhgüi bol tiim ersdel bii.

dialogue.speaker: Saruul
dialogue.mn: Тийм ээ, би өнөөдрөөс эхлээд өдөр бүр хичээллэнэ.
dialogue.en: You're right, I'll study every day starting today.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim ee, bi önöödröös ekhleed ödör bür khicheellene.

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.mn: Сайн байна. Тусламж хэрэгтэй бол би тусалъя.
dialogue.en: Good. If you need help, I'll help you.
dialogue.mn_latin: Sain baina. Tuslamj kheregtei bol bi tusalya.

culture_note.en: In many Mongolian universities, a student who fails a course can usually retake the exam, often for a fee or in a later session. Grades are often given as points out of 100 and turned into letter grades, and keeping a good average matters for state or university scholarships. Students often study together in groups before retakes.
culture_note.mn: Монголын олон их дээд сургуульд хичээлд унасан оюутан шалгалтаа дахин өгөх боломжтой бөгөөд ихэвчлэн төлбөртэй эсвэл дараагийн улиралд өгдөг. Дүнг ихэвчлэн 100 онооны системээр тооцоод үсгэн дүн болгодог бөгөөд төрийн болон сургуулийн тэтгэлэгт хамрагдахад дундаж дүн чухал. Дахин өгөхийн өмнө оюутнууд бүлгээрээ хамт хичээллэх нь элбэг.

review.notes: Mostly good; main problems are the inaccurate 'formal -вал+гүй' claim in the grammar, a few translation mismatches, and a poorly formed scholarship phrase in the dialogue. Some items I flagged as 'kept' need no change.

opus_fix.notes: Fixed an unnatural vocab item, case and spelling errors, an illogical sentence, and en/mn mismatches in the grammar and culture texts.

changes.why: 'хичээл завсарлах' means a class break; standard phrase for taking leave is 'чөлөө авах'
Natural English has no article: 'take leave'
'If you don't come, I won't wait' is illogical; adding 'on time' fixes it
Make the en and mn explanations say the same thing
The mn version was missing the Mongolian -хгүй бол part; now matches en
'таслаж' is a misspelling of 'тасалж'; natural phrase is 'хичээл тасалж'
Reflexive possessive is natural for one's own exam
'надаар тусламж хэрэгтэй' uses the wrong case
Matches en: 'often' (not 'заримдаа') and 'state or university scholarships'
